title: Add RAG agent templates and tool-calling quickstarts, update docs site
author: Aisha Patel
description: Motivation: provide production-ready RAG agent templates and tool-calling quickstarts to help developers get started faster. This PR adds a set of opinionated templates for retrieval-augmented generation agents, concrete tool-calling examples (search, database, and code-exec), and integrates the quickstarts into the docs site. Changes include new example repositories, updated docs nav, and small SDK snippets. Checklist: - [x] Add RAG agent templates (python/ts) - [x] Add tool-calling examples (search, sql, shell) - [x] Add docs pages and sidebar entries - [x] Add CI smoke tests for examples - [x] Update quickstart README and code snippets Related: ENG-3491 (RAG quickstarts), ENG-3540 (tool-calling examples). Notes: kept templates minimal and dependency-free; examples use the redwood SDK patterns and the examples CI uses a small mock backend to keep runs fast.
commits_summary: 3 commits: initial templates + quickstart examples; docs site integration; fix CI and wording in examples.
